scope: Interactive visual proposal; separate from the production game
observations: Frames and artwork retain their aspect ratios; labels, portraits and footer actions occupy separate regions.
Choice surfaces and symbols move together inside stable hit targets; selection and completion have distinct visible states.
The two children have separate portraits, choices and confirmation indicators.
Reward values, shorter time bar, mana and personal pet owner remain visually distinct.
Core path illustrations and mastered completion marks remain visible with words hidden and audio absent.

validation.database: No database dependency or migration required

limits: Tablet testing used browser viewport and touch emulation, not a physical tablet or child playtest.
Gameplay values are fixtures held in memory; production controllers remain authoritative.
Spoken introduction has not been recorded.
